paper_title: Constraining Axion-Like Particles with HAWC Observations of TeV Blazars
coupling_convention: g_agamma in 10^-11 GeV^-1 as plotted, emitted in absolute GeV^-1
notes: ALP-photon conversion limit from HAWC TeV blazar observations. Paper reports exclusion at >3 sigma for g_agamma > ~3e-11 GeV^-1 for ALP masses below ~200-300 neV (300 neV = 3e-7 eV). The exclusion is approximately a horizontal band at 3e-11 GeV^-1 up to a mass cutoff; encoded as a two-point line spanning the stated mass range (from lowest masses ~1e-11 eV up to 3e-7 eV). Detailed contour shape in Fig. 3/4 not extractable numerically from text. This is an astrophysical (LSW-type) bound, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density applies. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 38)) | Vision: Traced from Fig. 3, the combined >3sigma exclusion boundary.
